_comment: Cold integrity-canary policy DATA (ADR-0560, executing ADR-0556 D2). The canary is a scheduled from-empty build of the pinned target set below with the cache BYPASSED (no overlay, no actions/cache restore), whose output digests are byte-compared against the warm CAS entries for the same keys. The pinned set is the trunk graph the warm lanes share (gate-fleet-shared-graph + the binding //ci/... gate cone). PATH LIVENESS: every pinned pattern's root must exist in the tree — bundled_canary_targets_stay_inside_the_binding_gate_cone asserts it. This block previously pinned //cloud/cloud-ci/..., a tree the gate-fleet move VACATED, so the canary that anchors the whole warm-cache/RE trust chain would have built ZERO targets and reported success having verified nothing. Cadence lives in .github/workflows/cache-integrity-canary.yml (a tunable of ADR-0556 D2); this file owns WHAT is pinned, the workflow owns WHEN.
comparison: byte-equality of output digests (sha-256 manifest) for overlapping action keys — the registry-drift bar; tolerance widening is NOT permitted (ADR-0556 D2.4)
red_response: fail the canary job RED + flip specs/cache-warm-license.json warm_reads_licensed to false (suspend-all-warm); divergent-key eviction rides the canary reconciler successor (ADR-0556 D4.3), tracked as follow-up
